references.text: The blood of the sacrifice shall be sprinkled around on the altar, the same practice as for the guilt offering
The burnt offering shall be slaughtered on the north side of the altar, the same place as the guilt offering
The sin offering shall be slaughtered in the same place as the burnt offering, before the Lord's presence
The sin offering is slaughtered in the same place as the burnt offering
The sin offering is slaughtered at the place of the burnt offering
The blood shall be sprinkled on the wall of the altar; the rest shall be poured out at the base of the altar
The sin offering shall be slaughtered before the Lord's presence in the same place as the burnt offering
The introduction to the law concerning the guilt offering, which verse 2 continues to describe
The guilt offering is slaughtered at the holy place, where the sin offering and the burnt offering are slaughtered
The blood makes atonement on the altar; it explains the meaning of the sprinkling of blood
The blood shall be sprinkled around on the altar, the same ritual as for the guilt offering
Almost everything is cleansed with blood according to the law, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness
